shared_protocol.coarse_state: same coarse mesh, coarse FEM solution, recovered stress and ZZ field
shared_protocol.target_budget: same target DOF and three-percent upper tolerance
shared_protocol.terminal_evaluation: same full FEM solve and recovered ZZ metrics

vlm_trace_micro_pso.executor: five initial particles in two latent coordinates plus one update of four particles

amber_iterative_sizing_field.external_requirement: task-specific or multi-task AMBER checkpoint command
amber_iterative_sizing_field.protocol: current mesh graph -> node sizing field -> deterministic mesher -> repeat

local_prediction_h_afem.external_requirement: low-dimensional local enrichment or replacement predictor command
local_prediction_h_afem.protocol: six local candidates -> predicted globally effective error reduction -> exact added DOF -> cost-aware Dörfler marking -> global resolve

commands.execute_all: python -m comparison.benchmark_driver --execute --methods vlm amber local --amber-command 'python amber_infer.py --request {request} --response {response}' --local-command 'python local_patch_predict.py --request {request} --response {response}' --output-dir comparison_run
